title: TestPlan
description: The port-less recipe for one test: a named, versioned set of flows with a wall-clock duration. This is what the operator authors (CreateTestRequest.plan) AND what is embedded verbatim into header.json. It is deliberately free of bindings: server-side ports (flow_bindings) and server_host are allocated by test-control and carried alongside the plan in RunTestPayload / header, NOT inside it. The Flow $defs here are the SINGLE source for flow shape across the whole contract.

name.description: Human-readable plan identifier, e.g. "commute_v1". Recorded in header.json. Lowercase + underscores so it round-trips through file paths.

version.description: Plan version. Bump when the plan's flow set or per-flow parameters change. Lets analysis distinguish results from different revisions of the same named plan.

duration_sec.description: Total test duration. All flows share this duration; per-flow shorter durations are not modeled in v1.

flows.description: Ordered list of flows. flow_id values MUST be unique within the plan.

Flow.description: Discriminated by `type`. Port-less: the server port for each flow is allocated by test-control and lives in flow_bindings (see run_test_command.schema.json / header.schema.json), keyed by flow_id.

rate_pps.description: Probe send rate. The mobile sends; the server echoes.

packet_size_bytes.description: On-wire UDP payload size. Minimum 22 = ProbePacket v1 header+core (see contracts/packets/probe.md). Padding to a larger size uses trailing zero bytes.

ProbeFlow.description: UDP echo probe. Server-hosted echoer in v1 (UE-hosted echoer would invert invariant 5's initiation flow and is out of scope).

packet_size_bytes.description: On-wire UDP payload size. Minimum 30 = RealtimePacket v1 header+core; remaining bytes are trailing-zero padding.

RealtimeUdpFlow.description: Fixed-rate unidirectional UDP. For Bidirectional traffic, define two flows (one FromServer, one ToServer) with distinct flow_id.

target_bytes.description: Optional byte cap. If omitted, the flow runs until the plan duration elapses.

BulkTcpFlow.description: Bulk-throughput TCP. Bidirectional is modeled as two flows on separate connections (remediation 2.2).

FlowId.description: Plan-scoped flow identifier. Unique within a TestPlan. Carried verbatim in the wire packet header (u32 on the wire — narrower here for schema sanity). flow_bindings entries reference this.

Port.description: Server-side TCP/UDP port the UE connects to / sends to (invariant 5). Allocated by test-control.

FlowBinding.description: Server-allocated binding for one flow. Lives in RunTestPayload / header (not in the plan); referenced to the plan by flow_id. The single source for the binding shape.

UnidirectionalDirection.description: Bidirectional intentionally absent: model bidirectional traffic as two flows.
